definitions.explanation: An electrical appliance that removes excess moisture from the air, commonly used during the humid rainy season (tsuyu) and summer months in Japan to prevent mold and mildew.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}は{除湿機|じょしつき}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: A dehumidifier is essential during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {除湿機|じょしつき}を{使|つか}ってカビを{防|ふせ}ぐ。
examples.english: I use a dehumidifier to prevent mold.

examples.japanese: {除湿機|じょしつき}のタンクに{水|みず}がたまった。
examples.english: Water collected in the dehumidifier's tank.

examples.japanese: {部屋干|へやほ}しの{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{乾|かわ}かすのに{除湿機|じょしつき}が{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: A dehumidifier is useful for drying laundry hung indoors.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {除湿|じょしつ} (dehumidification) + {機|き} (machine)
・{除|じょ} - to remove
・{湿|しつ} - moisture, humidity
・{機|き} - machine

NOTE ON CHARACTERS: Uses {機|き} (machine) rather than {器|き} (device), as dehumidifiers are typically larger than humidifiers.

TYPES OF DEHUMIDIFIERS:
・コンプレッサー{式|しき} - compressor type (effective in summer)
・デシカント{式|しき}/{ゼオライト{式|しき}} - desiccant type (effective in winter)
・ハイブリッド{式|しき} - hybrid type (year-round)

COMMON USES:
・カビ{対策|たいさく} - mold prevention
・{洗濯物|せんたくもの}の{乾燥|かんそう} - drying laundry
・{結露|けつろ}{防止|ぼうし} - condensation prevention

RELATED TERMS:
・{除湿|じょしつ} - dehumidification
・{湿度|しつど} - humidity
・{梅雨|つゆ} - rainy season
